title: phpolars
summary: phpolars is a PHP extension, written in Rust, that runs the Polars data frame library inside PHP. Its API follows py-polars: DataFrame, LazyFrame, Series, and expressions, with lazy queries, time series windows, joins, SQL, and readers and writers for CSV, Parquet, JSON, Arrow IPC, and PDO. Queries run on Polars' own threads. phibble's PolarsTable adapter uses the extension to run phibble tables and phplyr pipelines in Polars.

verify.note: PHP-FPM reads its own php.ini, so enable the extension there and restart FPM.
